prompts.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: full-bleed website hero for SURFORM, a Brazilian solid-surface fabrication brand. Create ONE exceptionally realistic architectural interior photograph, wide landscape 16:9, at least 1672 pixels wide if possible. A believable contemporary Brazilian apartment kitchen, charcoal and graphite lacquer cabinetry, understated dark grey mineral-look wall cladding, pale grey large floor tiles, satin metal fixtures. No exposed wood grain. The visual subject is a warm off-white ACRYLIC SOLID SURFACE (SSM) peninsula about 190 by 90 cm, fully supported by charcoal base cabinets with straight coherent panel gaps, a single integrated rectangular sink with soft internal radii and one visible steel drain, one brushed stainless mixer faucet properly positioned behind the sink with spout reaching its interior. The counter is homogeneous subtly satin, matte light scatter, no marble veins, no porcelain texture, realistic fabricated edge and joints, not a stone waterfall block. Natural daylight from the right, restrained practical lighting, accurate verticals and perspective, 35 mm professional architectural photography, true material microtexture and believable reflections, no shiny plastic or CGI look. Compose the counter, sink and faucet around the middle-right of the image so a vertical mobile crop at 65% retains them. Keep the left third visually quiet with darker cabinets to accommodate ivory web headline. Camera at normal eye level, realistic 3m-wide apartment dimensions, not monumental architecture. Very few everyday objects, a folded cloth and a small plain ceramic bowl away from the sink; no people, text, logos, watermarks. The user's monochrome glossy kitchen reference inspires the graphite palette, but make a new space with refined satin finishes and solid-surface counter rather than copying its black veined stone.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: architectural photograph for SURFORM solid-surface website, ONE landscape 3:2 photograph. Design a real contemporary Brazilian apartment kitchen inspired by the user's pale greige L-shaped kitchen reference, but an original space. Calm greige matte lacquer cabinet doors, no exposed wood grain, off-white painted ceiling, light grey limestone-look porcelain wall panels with believable subtle joints, pale satin porcelain floor. Main subject is a homogeneous warm-white ACRYLIC SOLID SURFACE (SSM) L-shaped countertop with an integrated single rectangular sink, softly rounded internal corners and a visible single steel drain, satin finish and realistic straight fabricated edge, NO marble veins on the countertop. One brushed stainless faucet correctly aligned above the bowl by a right-hand window with sheer blind. Include integrated flush induction hob with proper clearances far from sink on the rear run, a small set of neutral ceramic vessels and a discreet towel; no architectural excess. Frame from the room entrance at normal eye height, perspective showing the continuous usable worktop, cabinets and sink; 35 mm lens, correct verticals and geometry, plausible dimensions about 2.8 by 3.5m. Soft real daylight, modest under-cabinet lighting, true microtexture and controlled reflections, professional interior magazine photography that looks built and lived in, not a shiny 3D render. Sink should be visible around 60% of frame width so a portrait card crop keeps the sink. No people, text, logos or watermark. No exposed wood, impossible cantilevers, extra sinks, duplicate faucets, tiled countertop, stone veins on SSM, extravagant styling.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: ONE landscape 3:2 architectural photo for SURFORM website's lavabo solid-surface applications. Create an original believable small Brazilian powder room about 1.5 by 2.4m inspired by the user's warm mineral-wall powder room reference. The walls use beige and grey stone-look large-format porcelain panels with subtle fine horizontal organic veining and real panel joints. The main subject is clearly a DIFFERENT MATERIAL: homogeneous warm off-white ACRYLIC SOLID SURFACE (SSM) vanity counter with one integrated rectangular bowl, gently radiused inner corners, visible metal drain, satin unpatterned finish and a realistic fabricated front edge. No veins on counter or basin. The solid-surface countertop is supported by matte greige lacquer drawer cabinets reaching nearly to the floor, no wood grain. One wall-mounted brushed nickel faucet projects correctly over the basin; no duplicate tap. Large simple mirror above, coherent reflection, warm overhead diffused architectural light plus a gentle hint of daylight through the entry; restrained neutral ceramic vase and soap dispenser far from the sink. Frame from the entry with a slight diagonal toward the basin so the countertop and its integration are the focal point. Keep sink and faucet in middle-left to center so a left-half website crop retains them. Natural scale, real joins, straight verticals, 40 mm architectural lens, realistic mineral wall texture with softer quiet surface on counter, believable shadows and reflection, high-quality photographic realism, not CGI. Do not show toilet. No giant palace, floating unsupported slabs, sculptural weird curves, wood grain, text, logos, watermark or people.
prompts.correctionPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Position it to the RIGHT of the existing wall faucet, approximately 15cm to the right of its circular wall base, on the porcelain wall below the mirror and above the counter. It must be a plausible single compact cylindrical control with a short lever, cleanly anchored to the wall, at realistic scale and with matching light/reflections. Keep the original wall spout, integrated bowl, drain, countertop, cabinet doors, mirror, objects, crop, all materials and lighting absolutely unchanged. Do not add any other fixtures or taps. Preserve photorealism and the homogeneous unpatterned acrylic solid-surface sink and countertop. One corrected photograph, same 3:2 landscape composition, no text, logos or watermark.
